observation: Each side uses a different font family throughout
evidence: A fonts_by_element_count: Montserrat (889 elements). B: system-ui (267 elements), with the h1 stack 'system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif'

observation: The H1 weight differs: A uses a regular weight and B uses bold
evidence: A h1 font_weight 400, 55px. B h1 font_weight 700, 54.4px

observation: Section H2 headings are medium weight and centered in A, but bold and left-aligned in B
evidence: A h2 weight 500/24px. Section titles like 'Baby product review categories' are visibly centered in A slice 00 and left-aligned in B slice 00. B h2 is 700/25.6px

observation: B places a short peach accent bar under every section heading
evidence: B slices 00–03 show a small peach rule under 'Baby product review categories', 'How Tell Me Baby works', 'Trending…', 'Recent reviews' and others. A's headings have no underline bar

observation: The two pages have different heading hierarchies
evidence: A heading_outline: 1 h1, 5 h3 (footer columns and newsletter) and 3 h2 (Login/Sign up/Forgot password modals), so its visible section titles are not h2. B: 1 h1, 7 h2 section titles, 1 h3 and 2 h4

observation: B wraps its content in a main element; A has none
evidence: semantic.main: A 0, B 1

observation: A has a much larger and more nested DOM
evidence: div count: A 528 vs B 25. Class total/unique: A 1407/383 vs B 161/28

observation: A loads many scripts and stylesheets; B has neither
evidence: scripts: A 52, B 0. Stylesheets: A 4, B 0. B has a single style tag

observation: A carries extensive SEO and social meta tags plus structured data; B has minimal head metadata
evidence: A has 37 meta tags (og:*, twitter:*, fb:app_id, 11 origin-trial) and 2 JSON-LD blocks. B has 3 meta names (charset, viewport, description) and 0 JSON-LD

observation: The page titles are worded differently

observation: B shows the second line of the H1 in peach and smaller type

observation: The hero search has an explicit Search button in B; A uses only a magnifier icon
